description: This file defines a script to automate the creation of database migration files by comparing the current database schema with the Prisma schema. It manages temporary PostgreSQL instances, executes Prisma CLI commands to detect schema differences, and writes migration SQL scripts to timestamped directories.

methods.name: create_migration(migration_name: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a new database migration SQL file by comparing the current database state with the Prisma schema, optionally using a provided migration name. Manages a temporary PostgreSQL database, executes Prisma CLI commands, and writes the diff output to a timestamped directory.

ctags.name: migration_name
ctags.pattern: /^    migration_name = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None$/

fields.name: migration_name = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None
